messages:
carmen: Customer reported big unit variance when mixing 128d and 2048d in a single request. They see same batch_size but 8x higher units.

lee: We currently only expose tokens and latency in Console. No per-request unit estimate.

naoki: Ingress computes a routing estimate. We can emit `X-Embed-Estimate-Units` and a compact `X-Embed-Estimate-BUCKETS` header. Keep it concise.

carmen: Important: label it clearly as an estimate, not billing. Add a small tooltip in Console.

lee: Perf note: computing full per-item breakdown is O(n). For headers compress to dims buckets like `128:4,2048:1`. Store full list in internal debug logs only.

ops-bot: Current proto example:
X-Embed-Estimate-Units: 4120
X-Embed-Estimate-BUCKETS: 128:4,2048:1;tokens:16480;pad:128

naoki: Metrics: emit `ingress_embed_estimate_units` histogram with labels tenant, route, dims_bucket. Console can sample for route dashboard.

carmen: UX: show per-request units, per-item avg, and a dims-bucket filter on the route dashboard. Add alert rule for sudden avg-unit spikes.

lee: Rollout plan: internal canary next week, opt-in for customers. Feature flag `console.embed_estimates_v1`.

naoki: I'll open the ingress PR to add headers + metrics behind the flag.

carmen: I'll draft tooltip copy and a short FAQ explaining mixed-dim penalties and quick mitigations (split requests, quantize, use dims hints).

lee: Good. Keep an eye on support channels for confusion.
